text:
Elaine: Kicking off QBR prep for Skyline Health — main asks: current token runway forecast, onboarding blockers, and an enablement plan to stop this becoming a renewal risk.
Marcos: Got it. Pulling spend now. Short answer: at current rate + embeddings, runway ~7 weeks. I'll post the breakdown in a sec.
Marcos: Breakdown: embeddings 62% of tokens last 30d, generation 28%, infra 10%. If they cut embedding sampling by 30% runway extends to ~10 weeks. :chart_with_downwards_trend: 
Elaine: Oof. Do we have any sudden spikes or a sustained uplift? Any recently shipped features that could explain it?
Susan: They rolled out batch similarity search 2 weeks ago and increased vector size to 1,280. That explains spike. Also their client is calling embeddings for every keystroke — we recommended debounce but haven't seen config changes yet.
Tyler: I'm scheduling a short enablement runbook with Skyline CS lead for tomorrow. Proposed agenda: 1) debounce + client-side batching 2) smaller vector dims or quantization 3) cost monitoring alerting
Elaine: Can you add proposed KB snippets and a short Loom? We want to include in the QBR doc.
Susan: Draft KB snippet:
```
- Debounce input: aggregate user typed events into 500ms windows
- Batch embeddings: send up to 64 inputs per request
- Consider reducing vector dim from 1280 -> 768 for fuzzy search; run A/B on recall
```
Susan: Also quick command to pull tokens by route:
```
redwoodctl billing tokens --account skyline-health --range 30d --group-by route
```
Marcos: Posting conservative 4-week and aggressive 8-week burn scenarios attachments (link saved to QBR folder). For immediate action, enabling prefix caching and a 30% embedding sample rate gives most bang for buck without breaking UX.
CostBot: ALERT: Skyline Health has crossed 80% of monthly budget threshold. Alert id: alerts/6789 — https://redwood/alerts/6789 :warning:
Elaine: Perfect — Tyler set the enablement invite and added Marcos for the cost deep-dive. Susan, can you record the KB and share by EOD?
Susan: Will do, recording ready by 5pm PST. I'll include before/after token estimates and a short AB test plan.
Tyler: I'll propose a canary rollout for the embedding sample; if recall drop >5% rollback automatically. Ops will watch latencies.
Elaine: For QBR slides, include: 1) current runway scenarios 2) proposed controls (debounce, batching, sample rate, quantization) 3) action owner + ETA 4) monitoring hooks & rollback criteria
Marcos: Agree. Also add a renewal risk flag: medium-high until next invoice; CS to confirm business impact metric (e.g., searches/day change).
Elaine: Thanks team. Sync 10:30am tomorrow. I'll draft the QBR slide deck after your notes.
Tyler: 10:30 confirmed. :thumbsup:
Marcos: Uploaded numbers to shared QBR deck. Link: https://redwood.drive/qbr/skyline
Elaine: Great. Closing actions: Susan record KB, Marcos finalize forecast, Tyler run enablement + canary, Elaine assemble slides. We'll follow up after the session.
